newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Sell Denmark's 2000 stg bond.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Sell Denmark's 2000 stg bond.

text.p: - Eurobond analysts' latest trade recommendations focused on sterling and dollars.
In sterling Denmark's 7.25 pct bond due December 2000 was the subject of two sell recommendations.
Sanwa International suggested swapping the bond for Denmark's 6.75 percent August 1998 bond, while Societe Generale recommended switching out of Denmark into Sweden's 7.625 percent bond due 2000.
Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:
STRATEGY This switch delivers a yield give-up of 10.5
b.p. The current spread is only 6.5 b.p. below the 1997 high and 48.5 b.p. above the three-month high. A switch between two gilts with similar maturities results in a larger yield give-up.
STRATEGY This switch is credit neutral, and offers a yield
pick-up of 14.5 b.p. despite moving five months shorter in duration. The Sweden bond is also more liquid.
BUY Allied Irish Bank step-up FRN 09/06
STRATEGY This bond has a step-up in the spread over Libor
in 2001,and is currently selling at Libor + 30 b.p. to the step-up.

The value of this bond can be judged against the Banc One 7.60 pct bond due May 2007. This is rated one notch higher by S&P and sells at 62 b.p. over Treasuries or Libor + 30 b.p. AIB therefore has the same spread as a bond six years longer in effective maturity.
STRATEGY The bond sells at libor + 66 b.p. to the step-up
in 2007, or in fixed rate terms stands at 98 b.p. over Treasuries.

This bond represents good value when compared to against the Royal Bank of Scotland perpetual bond that has a step-up in 2006. This trades at 84 b.p. over Treasuries, so is therefore trading tighter than BNP with a lower rating.
STRATEGY All the above bonds offer relative value.

Argentaria is currently trading around 72 b.p. over Treasuries and can be compared against the 7.60 pct Banc One 2007 bond at 62 b.p. over Treasuries. The Ontario bonds should benefit from the conclusion of the Canadian elections.
